nom: Glycolic Acid 50% Gel Peel - Enhanced with Retinol & Green Tea Extract (Professional Skin Peel)1 ounce

segments.oily: One reviewer with very oily skin says a single use removed enough excess oil to keep her face oil-free for three to five days.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers are divided on suitability for sensitive skin: several caution that this strength is too aggressive for sensitive or first-time users and describe burns even on skin they don't consider sensitive, while one reviewer describes it as suitable for sensitive skin and gentle enough to moisturize with a mild scent.
segments.mature: Reviewers managing signs of aging, including a 55-year-old with crow's feet and post-menopausal skin changes and a 36-year-old whose sun-damaged skin had become leathery, report smoother, tighter, more youthful-looking skin and smaller pores after building up tolerance gradually.

concerns.aging: A few reviewers managing fine lines, crow's feet or leathery sun-damaged texture report smoother, tighter, more youthful-looking skin with gradual, careful use; one notes visible improvement in fine lines around the eyes but no real reduction in deeper wrinkles.
concerns.dehydration: A couple of reviewers report the peel left their skin dry, including one whose skin became dry and broke out simultaneously; by contrast, one reviewer describes it as moisturizing with a mild scent, and another felt an initial moisturizing sensation before tingling set in.
concerns.redness: Reviewers who follow the recommended short contact times report mild, short-lived redness that fades within minutes to two days; reviewers who left the peel on too long describe more severe, lasting redness, dark red blotches or burning.
concerns.barrier: Several reviewers report serious skin-barrier injury when the peel was left on too long or used incorrectly, including welts and open wounds that took over a week to heal, chemical burns, and sores; reviewers who followed short contact times and built up tolerance gradually did not report this kind of damage.
concerns.spots: Several reviewers using it on hyperpigmentation, dark spots or acne scars report gradual fading and smaller-looking pores with weeks of consistent, careful use, including one who calls it more effective than anything else she tried for an acne scar; one dissenting reviewer with melasma says the peel made her skin feel smoother and tighter but did not visibly improve the melasma itself.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer says it helped calm hormonal breakouts, but two others report the opposite: one developed acne across her entire face after her first application despite following instructions exactly, and another whose cystic acne used to improve with this product says a reformulation now just burns without helping and leaves sores.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer with very oily skin reports a single use removed enough excess oil to leave her face oil-free for three to five days.

aspects.libelle: Requires precise timing to avoid burns
Sharp cap edges can cut hands
Scent is strong or inconsistent between batches
Far cheaper than professional spa peels
Detailed instructions included in the box
Skin feels noticeably smoother right after use

extraits.texte: I can not tell you how bad my acne got.. I followed the instructions exactly how they said.. timed every second.. did once a week, on my 1st application I got acne the next day, everywhere in my face, I kept cleaning and moisturizing religiously since the skin felt a little dry.. middle week it's started to go away so I thought maybe it's part of the process.. 2nd application was Tuesday.. last picture is from today Friday... I'm 32 and I look like I just hit puberty.. I don't see any improvement in my skin tone or marks.. only dry skin and acne everywhere. I wanted so bad this to work.. and it just made it worse..

I followed the directions precisely. I’m very good with skincare and know my stuff. Read the description and thought it was ok. My face burned and I have welts on my face and open wounds that will not close up. It’s been a week (2nd pic) and it’s not healing. Had to go to urgent care. It’s painful. Do not use. Go to a professional. Not worth saving money with this product. Pretty pissed.

extraits.titre: Need help for Melasma, Results with Pictures.
extraits.texte: I have been using this home peel since July 25th 2015. Today, August 27 2015, I am posting my results after 4 peels. Peel 1, 2, & 3 were all done 1 week apart and the 4th peel was two weeks after the 3rd. I was also using Vitamin C and Hyaluronic Acid everyday. After the Third Peel I started using skin bleaching from Obagi. Concerning the Perfect Image Glycolic Acid- My skin felt "fuller" and I thought the peels made my skin smoother immediately. I never had any skin peel off and my face was slightly red for 30 minutes after each peel. The heat from the peel intensifies slightly with each session but is manageable. I use baking soda to neutralize as I wash it off. This is my first at-home peel. I do see results that I would attribute to the Chemical Peel such as smoother skin, tighter skin and softer skin. I do not think the peel is helping me fight Melasma. My Black and White photos are taken with the Mono Setting on iPhone 6, I was trying to create contrast so the dark patches would show up. The color picture was taken 20 minutes after Peel #3 and my skin is irritated. As you can see the Melasma is not as bad as the B/W make it seem and most people do not notice, BUT I DO! Overall I will keep using it until it runs out because I like the way my skin feels but I will look into alternatives for Melasma treatments.

extraits.titre: Excellent product! Beautiful Packaging and premium product. 5 STAR
extraits.texte: I am 55 with melasma on my neck and sunspots. I have crows feet and my skin has changed since menopause. I have used 30% Glycolic Acid for over a decade and was ready for a stronger peel. I like that this peel has retinol and green tea extract. This peel is fantastic! The directions inside the box are complete and very informative. You can apply about 5 passes MAX with the cotton round. I only did two passes on my arms and legs. Gently in circular motion. If you are new to peeling, do less passes and when it starts to sting, rinse it off. You should be able to go longer each time you peel. Do not peel more than once a week! Maybe to the face every two weeks and the body every week. I applied to face, neck, chest and legs (not my knees but I just forgot! always forget the knees!) I left mine on for 14 minutes total but If you are a newbie please don't do it that long. I am a veteran peeler and my skin is adapted to 30% so 50% was just right. I am excited to see results. I have tried the TCA peels and they are disheartening and the peeling is unsightly. Rinse with cool water to neutralize the acid and put on squalane oil after, a gentle moisturizer or vaseline if your skin is tender. I like the smooth feel of my skin after. My skin is tender on my chin so I will only do a total of 8 minutes next time and three passes with a cotton swab. My skin was tingling on my arms and chest after 10 minutes. I also like to neutralize with baking soda and water mixed together on the stinging

extraits.titre: Does exactly what is says it is for
extraits.texte: I brought this glycolic acid after doing my research. It definitely does its job. It is a great exfoliator and it definitely did feel off my skin. I have very oily skin and after using this for just a minute it wipes off so much oil off from my face that I am oil free for about 3-5 days. I am really enjoying this product. So far I’ve used it for 2 weeks and the results so far have been great. I can’t wait to see my face after 3-6 months of using this glycolic acid.
